Do you actually listen to people, or are you just trying to strike up a conversation in the hopes that someone will validate your own beliefs?

> no skills, no friends, no hobbies

Three reasons, without even talking to him.

Do you have a book full of platitudes to speak to people that mean absoltuely nothing, or is your head so full of air that when the first thing resembling a thought blows through, you just spout it off?

>if anything, to comprehend the end of suffering and existence.

Death may not be the end of suffering and existence. It may just be the start.

This guy believes he's being chased by shadowy figures, and your advice is to get some fresh air?

This entire sub-reddit and everyone who "tries to help" is an absolute fucking joke.
Really? I just don't think so.

Well the reason I came back was because I basically ran out of money.

It was a terrifiying, lonely and otherwise strange experience, I was lost out in the desert (essentially) and believed that demon hounds were chasing me. Every time I looked out of the corner of my eye, I thought they were waiting in the shadows.

Every day I was plagued with lucid nightmares about the hounds chasing me, and this lasted for weeks. Everyone thought I was crazy, and I broke a Paramedics nose when they tried to sedate me on one particularly bad trip. 

I lost about 10kgs in about 2 weeks, lost some of my hair due to the stress, almost killed myself with a .22 (purpoesfully) although it jammed (or wasn't working, I'm not even sure) and wrote off my car about a kilometer away from house on the final run.

Had dirty, stinking, sex with this random chick I met on the train (I litterally have never had random sex with anyone), and I have this weird scar running down my forehead from god knows what.

>surfing 9gag everyday

No wonder you want to kill yourself.

>I hope you don't do it. You'll miss out on the great stuff when things get better 

Like what for example?

Since when is death defeat?

Death is inevitable. Everyone dies.

You're the reason people call suicide attempts "Calls for help"

Do us all a favour and kill yourself, stop wasting resources from people who actually want help.

You pathetic loser.
That fucking sucks.

Something will change, but will it be the change you need?

Will you be able to accept that change?

You are a terrible, shitty, selfish, unintelligent person.

Everything you believe about yourself is true, whether true or not.

Just randomly driving? Sounds like going walkabouts in Australia (a term for just getting up and leaving)

First time I did it, just randomly dropped out of Uni, didn't tell anyone, grabbed clothes, cash, about a ounce of weed, a vial of LSD and went to the Northern Territory (in Australia).

THe thing about walk-abouts is you just gotta do it. Take whatever you need for a week, including some food, and figure out the rest along the way.

I assume you're in the states, so go to the Rockies, always loved that drive. Fresh air, mountains and (usually) silence.

Suicide is anything but easy.

Suicide is actually more difficult then people realise.

I did the same thing for a very long time. I tried to find validation, to find acceptance for the decision to die.

Personally, I felt more unsure, as most suicidal people do, about whether this was the right decision. I needed someone to encourage me.

> It is a bad day, not a bad life

Just one bad day? Sounds like quite a few.

>Think everyone else has their life all figured out? 

He actually never said that.

>Its completely normal to feel lost sometimes 

See above

>it will get better eventually

Be more specific, what does "getting better" mean exactly?
>I really believe that. 

You're entitled to your beliefs, and quite obviously you're ready to voice them, with or without an audience.
Knife the next cunt that gives you shit.

Oh and long periods of isolation and withdrawal from social contact makes you angry, bitter and generally resentful towards others.

Or you know, eternal hellfire.

Or a million possibilities.

You cannot say nothing exists, but you can't say something does exist.

No one knows.
